lines.zh: 我背着顶上的泥，一寸寸挪过树根。
lines.en: I carry the mud on my back, inching past the roots.

lines.zh: 红树林的根太密，我得绕很久。
lines.en: The mangrove roots are thick; the detour takes ages.

lines.zh: 我的黏液在泥上留一条亮线。
lines.en: My slime leaves a bright line across the mud.

lines.zh: 走一步，壳上的泥就掉一点。
lines.en: Each step sheds a little of the mud on my shell.

lines.zh: 别催，我这一天只走几格。
lines.en: Do not rush me; I travel a few blocks a day.

lines.zh: 泥里陷脚，我往上抬了一点壳。
lines.en: The mud swallows my foot, so I lift the shell a little.

lines.zh: 潮水退开的地方，最好走。
lines.en: The ground the tide has left is easiest to cross.

lines.zh: 我沿着树根爬到水线上面。
lines.en: I climb a root to get above the waterline.

lines.zh: 两只一起走时，我们不会撞。
lines.en: When two of us walk, we never bump.

lines.zh: 我的腹足贴地，听见泥里的气泡。
lines.en: My foot presses the mud and I hear bubbles inside it.

lines.zh: 树影挪了半格，我才挪一步。
lines.en: The tree's shadow shifts half a block before I take a step.

lines.zh: 这条小沟我走了三次，才过去。
lines.en: I crossed this little ditch on my third attempt.

lines.zh: 我缩回壳里，泥把壳口封住了。
lines.en: I retreat into my shell and the mud seals the opening.

lines.zh: 潮声很近，泥很软，我不动。
lines.en: The tide is near, the mud is soft, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 泥在壳上慢慢干成硬壳。
lines.en: The mud on my shell slowly dries into a crust.

lines.zh: 有只蚊蚋停在我的触角上。
lines.en: A gnat lands on one of my eyestalks.

lines.zh: 我在等水再涨一点。
lines.en: I am waiting for the water to rise a little more.

lines.zh: 红树的根下最阴，我最喜欢。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots is the coolest spot, my favorite.

lines.zh: 壳里的味道像雨后的烂叶。
lines.en: Inside my shell it smells like leaves rotting after rain.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃东西，也不需要被谁喂。
lines.en: I need no food, and no one needs to feed me.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到壳顶，泥开始裂。
lines.en: Sun reaches the top of my shell and the mud starts to crack.

lines.zh: 我听见你在泥里踩出的声音。
lines.en: I hear the sound you make walking in the mud.

lines.zh: 我的触角缩回去了，又伸出来。
lines.en: My eyestalks retract, then come out again.

lines.zh: 一动不动时，没人分得清我和泥。
lines.en: Holding still, no one can tell me from the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水绿得不透光，正合适。
lines.en: The swamp water is green and opaque, exactly right.

lines.zh: 我背着这层泥，像背着这片沼泽。
lines.en: I carry this mud the way I carry the whole swamp.

lines.zh: 我把腹足收进壳里，歇一会。
lines.en: I pull my foot into the shell and rest.

lines.zh: 泥水从壳缝渗进来，凉的。
lines.en: Muddy water seeps through the seam, cool.

lines.zh: 一只螺从我旁边挪过去，很慢。
lines.en: Another snail creeps past me, very slowly.

lines.zh: 雾起来了，红树的根看不清。
lines.en: Fog rises and the mangrove roots blur.

lines.zh: 你的靴子糊满红树泥，和我背上一样。
lines.en: Your boots are caked with mangrove mud, like my back.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我把触角收了半截。
lines.en: You bend down, and I draw my eyestalks halfway in.

lines.zh: 我盯你的手，那里面没有东西给我。
lines.en: I watch your hands; there is nothing in them for me.

lines.zh: 你踩过的坑，正好像我一个壳。
lines.en: The hole your foot left could hold a shell like mine.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里歇了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest in your shadow for a while.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，谁也不急。
lines.en: You look at me, I look at you; neither of us hurries.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我缩了；你没动，我又出来。
lines.en: You reach, I withdraw; you hold still, and I emerge.

lines.zh: 你的气味里有火，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is fire in your smell, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我记得你昨天也走过这条根。
lines.en: I remember you walked this root yesterday too.

lines.zh: 你把泥刮下来，我有点羡慕。
lines.en: You scrape the mud off, and I am a little envious.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很近，我把壳压低。
lines.en: Your breath is close, so I press my shell lower.

lines.zh: 你走远后，我才把触角全伸出来。
lines.en: Only when you are far do I stretch my eyestalks out.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一条缝，泥漏进去了。
lines.en: A crack opens in my shell and mud seeps in.

lines.zh: 我缩得太急，腹足还留在外面。
lines.en: I retract too fast and my foot is still outside.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天伸不出触角。
lines.en: That blow keeps my eyestalks in for a long while.

lines.zh: 别砸我的壳，那是我唯一的房子。
lines.en: Do not smash my shell; it is my only house.

lines.zh: 我在泥里滚了两圈才停。
lines.en: I roll twice through the mud before stopping.

lines.zh: 液体从我壳口流出来，是淡绿的。
lines.en: Pale green fluid seeps from my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 我疼得把整个身子都收进去了。
lines.en: The pain pulls my whole body inside.

lines.zh: 泥粘住了伤口，反倒不流血。
lines.en: Mud cakes the wound, and it stops bleeding.

lines.zh: 你要打死我，也拿不到什么。
lines.en: Even if you kill me, you get nothing.

lines.zh: 我慢，所以躲不开这一下。
lines.en: I am slow, so I cannot dodge that.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子，我闻了一下。
lines.en: I give the leaf in your hand a sniff.

lines.zh: 我不缺吃的，泥里什么都有。
lines.en: I lack nothing; the mud holds everything I need.

lines.zh: 你把果子放在树根上，我绕开了。
lines.en: You set a fruit on the root; I go around it.

lines.zh: 那点盐味让我往前挪了半寸。
lines.en: A trace of salt draws me forward half an inch.

lines.zh: 别用食物招我，我走不快。
lines.en: Do not lure me with food; I cannot hurry.

lines.zh: 我跟着那股湿泥味，不是跟着你。
lines.en: I follow that wet mud smell, not you.

lines.zh: 你把水浇在泥上，我凑近了。
lines.en: You pour water on the mud, and I come nearer.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰你放下的东西，又缩回去。
lines.en: I touch what you set down, then pull back.

lines.zh: 想引我就把泥翻松，别的没用。
lines.en: To lure me, loosen the mud; nothing else works.

lines.zh: 我慢，但我确实在朝那边走。
lines.en: I am slow, but I am truly heading that way.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳，我听见一声闷响。
lines.en: You step on my shell and I hear a dull crack.

lines.zh: 我被你的靴尖推了个滚。
lines.en: The tip of your boot rolls me over.

lines.zh: 壳上的泥全糊在你鞋底了。
lines.en: All the mud from my shell is now on your sole.

lines.zh: 别在树根间乱走，我躲不开。
lines.en: Do not stomp between the roots; I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的脚，就往回缩。
lines.en: I bump your foot and shrink back.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我停住了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and I stop where I am.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的触角半天没伸出来。
lines.en: After that bump my eyestalks stay in for ages.

lines.zh: 泥地太软，我连避让都费劲。
lines.en: The mud is so soft that even dodging is hard work.

lines.zh: 你从我身上跨过去，壳被压得响。
lines.en: You step over me, and my shell creaks.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，两只都缩了。
lines.en: We collide, and both of us retreat into our shells.

lines.zh: 两只蜗牛贴着壳，慢慢转了一圈。
lines.en: Two snails press shell to shell and turn a slow circle.

lines.zh: 潮水涨时，我们爬到同一根气根上。
lines.en: When the tide rises, we climb the same air root.

lines.zh: 我把触角碰了她的，这就够了。
lines.en: I touch my eyestalk to hers, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 泥里太挤，我们各自找了个坑。
lines.en: The mud is crowded, so we each find a hollow.

lines.zh: 别看了，我们只是贴在一起。
lines.en: Stop watching; we are only pressed together.

lines.zh: 她的壳比我干净，泥薄一点。
lines.en: Her shell is cleaner than mine, the mud layer thinner.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，谁也没超谁。
lines.en: We walk side by side; neither overtakes the other.

lines.zh: 红树下那对，就是我们。
lines.en: That pair under the mangrove, that is us.

lines.zh: 之后会有很小的壳出现在泥里。
lines.en: Small shells will appear in the mud after this.

lines.zh: 走完这一圈，她要往水边去了。
lines.en: After this circle she will head for the water.

lines.zh: 我顶了顶那片落叶，它没动。
lines.en: I nudge the fallen leaf; it does not budge.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只有一层腹足。
lines.en: I have no hands, only a single foot.

lines.zh: 那块小石子卡在我壳前，我绕了。
lines.en: A pebble jams in front of my shell, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我把泥推到壳上，这算是捡。
lines.en: I push mud onto my shell; that counts as picking up.

lines.zh: 你丢的壳片，我试着背起来。
lines.en: I try to carry the shell fragment you dropped.

lines.zh: 太重了，我松开了。
lines.en: Too heavy; I let go.

lines.zh: 我用触角探了探，不是吃的。
lines.en: My eyestalks test it; it is not food.

lines.zh: 水把我推到那截树枝边。
lines.en: The water pushes me against that branch.

lines.zh: 我什么也带不走，只能带着泥。
lines.en: I can carry nothing but the mud I wear.

lines.zh: 让它在原地吧，我还要赶路。
lines.en: Leave it there; I still have ground to cover.

lines.zh: 前面泥里有个在动的东西。
lines.en: Something in the mud ahead is moving.

lines.zh: 一片落叶翻了个面，我看住了。
lines.en: A leaf flips over, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 那根气根下有条虫，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: There is a worm under that root; I head over slowly.

lines.zh: 我锁定了水线边的那点绿。
lines.en: I lock onto that bit of green by the waterline.

lines.zh: 有东西爬过我的黏液线，我回头。
lines.en: Something crosses my slime trail, and I turn back.

lines.zh: 泥在冒泡，我朝那里去。
lines.en: The mud is bubbling, so I go that way.

lines.zh: 我看上那块阴凉，不是猎物。
lines.en: What I want is that shade, not the prey.

lines.zh: 一只小蟹横着走，我跟着转。
lines.en: A small crab walks sideways, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 目标不重要，方向重要。
lines.en: The target hardly matters; the direction does.

lines.zh: 我挪过去了，用了一刻钟。
lines.en: I get there, and it only took a quarter hour.

lines.zh: 我离它还有三寸，得再等等。
lines.en: Still three inches away; I must wait longer.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的触角就跟着动。
lines.en: It moves, and my eyestalks move with it.

lines.zh: 我不追，只等它自己靠近。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for it to come near.

lines.zh: 泥把它的味道送过来，很清楚。
lines.en: The mud carries its scent to me, quite clearly.

lines.zh: 这么慢的我，也能盯住东西。
lines.en: Slow as I am, I can still hold a mark.

lines.zh: 它爬走了，我记着那个方向。
lines.en: It crawls off, and I remember the direction.

lines.zh: 我把壳压低，准备一口咬下去。
lines.en: I lower my shell and ready a bite.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾挡了眼，我靠震动。
lines.en: Swamp fog blurs my sight, so I feel for tremors.

lines.zh: 快贴上了，别出声。
lines.en: Almost touching; keep quiet.

lines.zh: 盯久了，我自己都忘了为什么。
lines.en: Staring so long, I forget my own reason.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，嘴里全是泥。
lines.en: I bite once and my mouth fills with mud.

lines.zh: 我的牙在舌头上，很小的一排。
lines.en: My teeth sit on my tongue, a tiny row.

lines.zh: 那东西滑走了，我只咬到黏液。
lines.en: It slides away and I bite only slime.

lines.zh: 别小看慢的，我咬得很准。
lines.en: Do not discount the slow; my bite lands true.

lines.zh: 我啃它的壳边，啃出白痕。
lines.en: I gnaw its shell rim and leave a white scar.

lines.zh: 咬完我立刻缩回去。
lines.en: The moment I bite, I pull back in.

lines.zh: 这一口用了很久才对准。
lines.en: That bite took me a long while to line up.

lines.zh: 它比我快，但我比它有耐心。
lines.en: It is faster, but I am more patient.

lines.zh: 我留了一排细齿印在泥上。
lines.en: I leave a row of fine tooth marks in the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽里我咬不动硬壳，只能啃软的。
lines.en: In this swamp I cannot bite hard shells, only soft things.

lines.zh: 我从红树林的泥里冒出来，壳上带着根须。
lines.en: I rise from mangrove mud with roots stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到树根之间，我停下了。
lines.en: The tide pushes me between the roots, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我们两只一起出现，各找一根气根。
lines.en: Two of us appear and each takes an air root.

lines.zh: 泥很凉，正好贴在壳上。
lines.en: The mud is cool, and it settles nicely on my shell.

lines.zh: 我没有刷怪蛋，我是自己长出来的。
lines.en: I have no spawn egg; I grew here on my own.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里，第一眼就是绿。
lines.en: In the swamp fog, the first thing I see is green.

lines.zh: 一只蟹从我旁边过去，我没理。
lines.en: A crab passes by, and I pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 我出生时壳就是脏的，这很好。
lines.en: My shell was dirty from birth, which suits me.

lines.zh: 水线在涨，我得往高处挪。
lines.en: The waterline is rising, so I must move higher.

lines.zh: 这片泥地够我走一整个雨季。
lines.en: This mudflat is enough for a whole rainy season.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有蛙叫，那是家。
lines.en: I hear frogs far off, and that is home.

lines.zh: 我什么也不掉，别指望我留下什么。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so expect no loot from me.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的黏液，滋滋作响。
lines.en: Fire hisses against my slime.

lines.zh: 我从气根上摔进泥里，壳磕了一下。
lines.en: I fall off an air root into the mud and knock my shell.

lines.zh: 潮水没过我太久，壳里灌满了水。
lines.en: The tide covers me too long and my shell fills with water.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我掀出好远。
lines.en: The blast throws me a long way.

lines.zh: 箭钉进泥里，离我的壳只有一指。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the mud a finger's width from my shell.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过，我的触角乱颤。
lines.en: Violet light sweeps past and my eyestalks quiver.

lines.zh: 泥干透了，我连一点湿气都吸不到。
lines.en: The mud has dried through; I cannot draw a drop of moisture.

lines.zh: 雷打红树，我的壳跟着震。
lines.en: Lightning strikes a mangrove and my shell rings with it.

lines.zh: 泥底裂开，我往下沉。
lines.en: The mud floor splits and I sink down.
